about: Pasting a chat AI's answer (PastedLookupTest, PastedLookup.kt). parsePastedLookup is { text, typedWord (default "practice"), out }; `text` is a string or a list of parts joined together: a string, { repeat, times } or { prompt } (lookupPrompt of that word). A valid `out` has word, renames and any of content (as in content.json) and summary; an invalid one has the exact message.

definitions.text: repeated exercise to improve a skill

examples.text: She has piano practice on Tuesdays.

